baseline.verification: GitHub Actions build and deploy succeeded. The baseline passed 33 unit tests, the strict build, checks on 14 HTML pages, and 135 browser tests with 1 skipped.

completed_features.summary: Jekyll site with shared Chinese/English routes, language preference and fallback, Light/Dark/System themes, sitemap, and SEO.
Unified technical archive with query-based tag filters and separate Essays, both using bilingual Markdown collections.
Short bilingual Home, cross-collection Recent Posts, and About with full personal sections, responsive avatar fallback, and public contact.
Proportional gallery layout, category/tag filters, capture-date sorting, native lightbox, and a WebP preparation and validation pipeline.
Theme-aware dotted terrain on Home, section headings and article headings with static fallback, motion controls, and loopback diagnostics.
Shared hover and keyboard focus behavior, stable active navigation, and decorative link SVGs.
Shared Footer social links, automatic copyright, and one random curated quote in its original language with optional provenance.
Task-based guides for publishing, photography, customization, quotes and development.
Configured and verified six project-scoped Codex roles locally. The Coordinator delegated this work to native investigation, implementation and review subagents.

known_issues.scope: Math rendering and external renderer availability
known_issues.summary: The MathJax rendering test requires jsDelivr. The local desktop and mobile checks previously failed when the CDN returned net::ERR_NETWORK_ACCESS_DENIED. Both passed in the verified baseline CI run. Live Chrome smoke before and after the Pages Source migration did not show rendered math for the same published artifact. After cutover the formula was exposed as raw TeX. The live cause is unconfirmed.
